title: Associate Solutions Engineer
description: Seeking an associate solutions engineer to deliver customer demonstrations, gather requirements, explain CRM workflows, partner with sales teams, and present technical solutions. Desired skills include CRM, SQL, dashboards, stakeholder communication, product demonstrations, and cloud integrations.

title: Customer Success Specialist
description: Help enterprise customers adopt software. Responsibilities: onboarding, training sessions, customer success plans, customer communication, CRM tracking, Excel reporting, problem solving and presentation. Preferred experience in Salesforce and process improvement.

title: Sales Operations Analyst
description: Analyze sales operations pipeline, improve CRM data quality, create Excel dashboards, write SQL queries, provide weekly reporting, support forecast processes and sales enablement. Work closely with sales leaders, operations, and finance stakeholders.

title: Business Analyst
description: Gather business requirements, map workflows, document user stories, analyze datasets, conduct stakeholder interviews, coordinate UAT and build Excel reports. SQL and customer communication experience are preferred.

title: CRM Implementation Coordinator
description: Coordinate CRM implementation projects, configure customer workflows, document requirements, support Salesforce adoption, maintain documentation, deliver customer training, track milestones, and collaborate with technical consultants.

title: Technical Account Associate
description: Support customer accounts by investigating support issues, managing onboarding, coordinating with product teams, creating data reports, conducting training and maintaining CRM documentation. Strong stakeholder communication and analytical skills required.

title: Junior Data Analyst
description: Analyze operational data using SQL and Excel, maintain data quality, build reporting dashboards, communicate findings with business stakeholders, and support improvements to reporting processes.

title: Product Enablement Specialist
description: Develop product demonstrations and customer training materials, organize sessions, support software adoption, synthesize product feedback, partner with sales enablement, and evaluate training metrics using Excel.

title: Business Development Operations
description: Maintain CRM workflows, support pipeline reporting, coordinate with field sales, develop Excel reports, document sales procedures and build dashboards to measure funnel conversion and customer engagement.

title: Support Operations Specialist
description: Coordinate support operations, investigate customer issues, improve customer onboarding processes, create reports, maintain CRM records, write documentation and communicate with customer success teams.

title: Implementation Analyst
description: Support client discovery, gather requirements, document integrations, build process maps, coordinate implementations, deliver training, and measure outcomes using Excel, SQL and CRM reporting.

title: Associate Customer Engineer
description: Translate customer requirements into technical demos, explain software products, deliver live presentations, collaborate with sales and engineering, build dashboards, and advise customers on CRM and cloud processes.
